verdict.rationale: The evidence documents manual or agent-invoked update operations: the CLI can 'update' memories, and the MCP tools let an agent 'update what it already knows'. Nothing shows the memory layer itself detecting contradictions and superseding or merging stored memories. Those update primitives and memory expiration are adjacent building blocks, not automatic conflict resolution, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the memory layer to update, supersede, or merge memories when new information contradicts what was stored
